name: Hoarfrost Needle (Sương Châm)

arts.name: Hoarfrost Prick (Sương Châm Thích)
arts.rule: A needle of frost: a quick Cold hit that lays 1 Ice stack for 8 s.

lore: A silver needle that never loses its frost; acupuncturists of the northern sects use it to numb.
build_use: The Frozen Treasury's first weapon: a fast, cheap Ice-stack source, so the foe's art costs begin to climb at once.

name: Rimed Band (Sương Giới)
lore: A ring of pale jade that is always coated with a thin rime.
build_use: The Frozen Treasury and The Frost Lock: each Ice stack bites harder, and a little health and linh lực flow for the early fights.

name: Hoarfrost Fan (Sương Phiến)

arts.name: Frost-Tithe Gust (Sương Thuế Phong)
arts.rule: A cold gust that lays 2 Ice stacks for 8 s. With 8 Ice stacks on the foe it eats 4 of them, hits twice as hard and delays the foe's slowest art by 0.5 s.

lore: Cranes' feathers frozen in a spring of the northern peaks, then bound to a bamboo frame.
build_use: The Frozen Treasury: a fast stacker whose gust turns a pile of Ice into a delay, and Rime Lock stalls the foe's best art at 10 stacks.

name: Sleeping Marrow Pendant (Miên Tủy Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Winter Sleep Aura (Đông Miên Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, healing taken is 10 % higher and health regeneration is 15 % increased.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (9.5 W)

lore: Blue-white jade that holds a thread of the cold that stills a hibernating beast's blood.
build_use: The Ice Physician: pills that would poison anyone else sit easy in the blood, and the pendant turns the extra healing into a steady mend.

name: Hoarfrost Tide Shield (Sương Triều Thuẫn)

wards.name: Hoarfrost Tide (Sương Triều Tráo)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.25 times its payload and its per-hit payment, so the price check is unchanged (2.935 of 3.050)

lore: A round shield of blue ice that sweats cold water; the blows run off it like a tide.
build_use: The Frozen Treasury and The Ice Physician: a light ward for slow fights where the foe's few heavy hits matter and linh lực is kept for arts.

name: Winter Toll Seal (Đông Toán Ấn)

arts.name: Toll Stamp (Toán Ấn Áp)
arts.rule: Counts as a Winter Toll Canon art. A slow cold seal that lays 3 Ice stacks for 8 s and adds a Frost. With 10 Ice stacks on the foe, and either 2 Frost or another Winter Toll art fired in the last 3 s, it eats 5 stacks and 2 Frost and falls two and a half times as hard.

lore: The seal the toll-keepers of the Winter Toll lineage stamped on every pass that crossed their frozen river.
build_use: The Frozen Treasury and The Frost Lock with the Winter Toll Canon: another canon art that builds the shared Frost, so Shatter Palm and the thaw break fire sooner.

name: Glacier Plate (Băng Xuyên Giáp)

wards.name: Glacier Shell (Băng Xuyên Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 1.4 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (3.750 of 3.813)

lore: Plates cut from a glacier's heart and sewn onto hide; they crack loudly, and the crack hurts.
build_use: The Shattering Mantle builds of the Stilled Hour Sutra: every shield that breaks bursts against the foe, and the ward comes back every 4 s.

name: Black Ledger Mirror (Huyền Trướng Kính)

effects.name: Toll Taker (Thu Thuế Giả)
effects.rule: When the enemy pays art cost that your Ice stacks added, you restore linh lực equal to 10 % of that extra cost.
effects.reads: The extra art cost your Ice stacks add to the enemy's arts, live
effects.from: variant-ice.md, The Frozen Treasury (Frost Tithe, as a smaller Effect on an item)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

reserve_arts.name: Cold Ledger Aura (Hàn Trướng Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Ice debuff stacks last 25 % longer.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W

lore: A mirror of black ice in which a moneylender's ledger can be read backwards; whoever is reflected pays more.
build_use: The Frozen Treasury: the foe's inflated costs also refill the cultivator, so a long fight against an expensive foe feeds the Ice build.

name: Deep Freeze Ring (Thâm Đống Giới)

effects.name: Deep Freeze (Thâm Đống)
effects.rule: Each time your Ice stacks on a target cross a multiple of 10, that target's art with the least time left is delayed by 1 s, once every 2 pulses.
effects.reads: Your Ice stacks on the target crossing a multiple of 10, instant
effects.payload: A 1 s delay on the target's art with the least time left
effects.closes: Your arts cost 10 % more linh lực.
effects.from: variant-ice.md, The Frost Lock (New piece: Deep Freeze)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

holder: A Nascent Soul Ice cultivator of a northern sect; otherwise Lost under a frozen lake
lore: A band of ice that has not thawed since the first winter, and in whose depth every year of cold can be seen.
build_use: The Frost Lock's keystone piece: Rime Lock stops being a one-time delay and becomes a lock at every 10 stacks, so the foe's slowest art never lands.

name: Moonrime Flying Sword (Nguyệt Sương Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Moon Stills the Tide (Nguyệt Đình Triều)
arts.rule: Counts as a Stilled Hour Sutra art. A cold sword stroke that lays 2 Ice stacks for 8 s and 1 Slowed Time. With 10 Ice stacks on the foe, and either 2 Slowed Time or two Sutra arts fired this pulse, the moon stills the tide: it eats 6 stacks, hits three and a half times as hard, delays the foe's slowest art by 0.5 s and lays a further Slowed Time for 5 s.

holder: An elder of a northern sword sect at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost in a snow-buried sword tomb
lore: A sword forged on the longest night of a winter that lasted three years, so that its light is the moon's.
build_use: The Frost Lock with the Stilled Hour Sutra: a sutra sword that stops time for a whole pulse when Volley and Instant have set the table.
